notes.title: Unveiling Shadow of Nyx: The Evolution of Project G.A.E.A.
notes.content:
First of all, I'd like to take a moment to thank all of you who've wishlisted the game until now. If you haven't yet, then I'd strongly recommend you do as development has picked up and more content will be coming soon.

Some of you may have noticed a "new game" in your wish list that you haven't added. Let me clear up the confusion. The game was previously announced as [b]Project G.A.E.A.[/b] which was a suitable name for the initial story of the game. Unfortunately, as the development of the game progressed further I noticed that the name just did not fit anymore.

Before further ado, I'd like to share the new title. [b]Shadow of Nyx![/b]
As the title suggests the goddess Nyx will play a significant role in the game's story. I'll let you wonder how much or how little her presence will influence the story or in what way. Just don't get too wild with your imagination.

Most of the art on the project is still old and unfortunately will be this way for some time as I'm still primarily focusing on creating a good experience, rather than eye candy. Don't worry, I'm very well aware that visual candy is important but I want to first make sure the gameplay is fun before focusing on making everything pretty. It's much much easier to make good-looking screenshots than great gameplay.

In that spirit, I'd like to thank you for your support. If you want to learn more about the game and it's development you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/fRZk2rJh9s]Discord[/url].

Thanks. Bye =)
